newsitem.title: USA: Mosinee Paper sees record results.
newsitem.headline: Mosinee Paper sees record results.

text.p: Mosinee Paper Corp said Monday it expected to report record earnings this year.

On Monday, Mosinee said its profits for the second quarter rose to $0.55 a share, a record for any quarter, from $0.48 a share a year earlier. Net income was $8.3 million versus $7.6 million in the second quarter of 1996.
"The positive results of the second quarter reflect the success of our strategy to position Mosinee Paper in niche markets," said Daniel Olvey, president and chief executive.

"We continue to focus on being a major producer of technical specialty papers for a multitude of industrial needs where we command higher margins for our production expertise. Additionally, we have successfully increased our share of the away from home towel and tissue market and are excited about a new touch-free towel dispenser which we plan to introduce later this year. As a result we believe Mosinee is on track for another year of record earnings in 1997."

During the second quarter, sales rose to $85.3 million from $79.2 million in the same period last year. The rise was driven by volume for Bay West towel and tissue and specialty paper products, the company said.
